client.stdin: 80-byte request header; OPEN is followed by exactly payload_len opaque JSON bytes
client.stdout: 16-byte output header plus exact payload_len bytes
client.lifetime: one live connection through native terminal plus every S closure; caller/controller death, stdin EOF before terminal or STOP revokes execution; native original endpoints never extend

envelope.authority: fixed trusted authority request interpreted only by fresh private-UID Node

fds.6: 32-byte reply header plus stdout then stderr

native_proof_hash: SHA-256 of the exact native terminal JSON body before adding proof_sha256; native journal stores this digest, then the original cleanup endpoint is rechecked before publication
positive_terminal: status=completed, all physical/drain/readback/journal booleans true, commands>=1, authority_status=0, observed_ns<cleanup_deadline_ns; opaque A result alone is never acceptance

operations.2: REGISTER_WRITER: direct child PID, no payload/FD
operations.3: OPEN: exactly one sealed non-executable memfd; native init birth stays gated
operations.4: STOP: native bridge first latches independent cancel pipe, then socket notification
operations.5: OBSERVE: live storage count/phase only, no caller-supplied proof
operations.6: PERMIT: exactly once after opened and durable containment binding; no payload/PID/FD

source_manifest: SHA256 of UTF-8 lines <file-sha256> knowledge/<relative>\n, UTF-8 byte-sorted, filtered by importer.allowedSourcePath and sourcePolicy; mutable maintenance/maps/memory excluded
runtime_manifest: SHA256 of the protected runtime.manifest bytes: same line grammar for Node, ELF loader/libs and allowlisted knowledge source; broker verifies each physical root-owned/no-ACL/no-symlink file before READY=1
cancel_capability: HELLO response passes a write-only root-owned FIFO with a distinct OFD from the root broker writer; caller file-status mutation cannot make the broker blocking
private_copy_lifetime: tmpfs128MiB/65536inodes mounted after MS_PRIVATE in the existing private mount namespace; exact native drain releases bytes; host cleanup only rmdir of empty fixed paths
storage_custody: separate per-S cgroup; exact S+guardian pidfds, native full cgroup.kill/drain, durable record removal and original/min cleanup endpoint; private A/W cgroup receipt never substitutes for S closure
lost_custody: keeper death while broker survives: retained exact init pidfd + subreaper fallback; broker death: native guardians stop independently, unresolved durable records fence same-boot restart; no age/absence/PID-reuse shortcut
